title: gravitas.extension-archive/1
description: The .gxp archive of an extension is not JSON: a POSIX ustar archive, gzip-compressed, deterministic (entries sorted by path, every mtime 0, mode 0644), whose first entry is the manifest `gravitas-extension.json`, whose last is `CHECKSUMS` (one "sha256  path" line per other entry) and which holds no directory, link, device, absolute or `..` path, no duplicate and at most 64 entries (4 MiB packed, 16 MiB unpacked). It carries no version of its own; its structure is checked (sdk/lib/archive.mjs read(), js/catalog/archive.js readTar(), which refuse alike), and the manifest it holds is gravitas.capability-package/1. The schema states the archive's listing, the entries of the unpacked archive with their sizes, which is what a reader checks and a tool can print as JSON. What gzip and tar bytes make of a corrupt file (a bad header, a truncated entry, a gzip bomb) is the reader's. FORMATS.md lists it.
